subject: science
concept: Identifying major body systems (skeletal, muscular, digestive, respiratory, circulatory) and their general purpose
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Function) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student assembles a simple virtual body-system diagram by placing organ pieces in the right system
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a body system to its general job in the body
exercise.abstract: Student names the body system responsible for a described function

misconception_flags: confuses which system performs which major function (e.g. digestion vs. respiration)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
